UserStoreSnapshot.title: UserStoreSnapshot
UserStoreSnapshot.description: Persistent snapshot of RadikMap user profiles, Telegram auth codes, and browser auth sessions.

usersJson.description: Serialized JSON map of user profiles

authCodesJson.description: Serialized JSON map of active Telegram login codes

authSessionsJson.description: Serialized JSON map of browser login sessions

botTemplatesJson.description: Serialized JSON map of customizable Telegram bot message templates

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last update

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Individual user profile synced with Telegram and RadikMap web app.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether 15-minute Telegram lesson reminders are enabled

lastNotifiedSlot.description: Last notified lesson slot key to prevent duplicate notifications

/radikmap_state/{docId}.description: Stores the persistent UserStore state for RadikMap backend and Telegram bot.
